messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

You will be given a piece of text and a list of relational triples in the format of [Subject, Relation, Object] extracted from the text. For each relation present in the triples, your task is to write a description to express the meaning of the relation.

Here are some examples:
Example 1:
Text: Lipitor (atorvastatin) belongs to a group of drugs called statins. Lipitor is used together with diet to lower blood levels of "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and to reduce the risk of stroke and heart attack.
Triples: [["Lipitor", "has generic name", "atorvastatin"], ["Lipitor", "belongs to drug class", "statins"], ["Lipitor", "treats", "high LDL cholesterol"], ["Lipitor", "reduces risk of", "stroke"]]
Relations: ["has generic name", "belongs to drug class", "treats", "reduces risk of"]
Answer:
has generic name: The subject drug is known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
belongs to drug class: The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological drug class specified by the object entity.
treats: The subject drug is used to treat or manage the medical condition specified by the object entity.
reduces risk of: The subject drug is used to lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.

Example 2:
Text: You should not use metformin if you have severe kidney disease. Tell your doctor if you have ever had liver disease. Metformin may cause lactic acidosis, a serious condition. Avoid drinking alcohol while taking metformin.
Triples: [["metformin", "contraindicated in", "severe kidney disease"], ["metformin", "use with caution in", "liver disease"], ["metformin", "has serious side effect", "lactic acidosis"], ["metformin", "should be avoided with", "alcohol"]]
Relations: ["contraindicated in", "use with caution in", "has serious side effect", "should be avoided with"]
Answer:
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
use with caution in: The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
has serious side effect: The subject drug may cause the serious or dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity.
should be avoided with: Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.

Example 3:
Text: Amlodipine is available as oral tablets in strengths of 2.5 mg, 5 mg, and 10 mg. Overdose symptoms may include rapid heartbeats and fainting. Norvasc is made by Pfizer.
Triples: [["amlodipine", "has dosage form", "oral tablet"], ["amlodipine", "has strength", "2.5 mg"], ["amlodipine", "has overdose symptom", "fainting"], ["Norvasc", "manufactured by", "Pfizer"]]
Relations: ["has dosage form", "has strength", "has overdose symptom", "manufactured by"]
Answer:
has dosage form: The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
has strength: The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
has overdose symptom: An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
manufactured by: The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.

Now please write relation descriptions given the following text and triples. Note that the description needs to be general and can be used to describe relations between other entities as well. Pay attention to the order of subject and object entities. Write exactly one line per relation in the form "relation: description" and nothing else.
Text: You may have a higher risk of seizures if you use certain other medicines while taking bupropion.
Many drugs can interact with bupropion.
Tell your doctor about all medicines you use, and those you start or stop using during your treatment.
This includes prescription and over-the-counter medicines, vitamins, and herbal products.
Some examples of drugs that interact with bupropion are:
Digoxin: May decrease plasma digoxin levels.
Monitor digoxin levels
MAOIs: Increased risk of hypertensive reactions can occur when used concomitantly with Bupropion.
Drugs that lower seizure threshold: Dose bupropion with caution.
Medicines that are CYP2B6 inducers may require a dose increase if coadministered with other CYP2B6 inducers.
Examples of CYP2B6 inducers include ritonavir, lopinavir, efavirenz, carbamazepine, phenobarbital, and phenytoin.
Dose increases should be based on clinical response.
Dose increases should not exceed the maximum recommended dose.
Medicines that are CYP2B6 inhibitors may require dose adjustment if coadministered with CYP2B6 inhibitors.
Triples: [["Bupropion", "increases risk of", "seizures when used with certain medicines"], ["Bupropion", "interacts with", "many drugs"], ["Bupropion", "has administration instruction", "tell your doctor about all medicines you use"], ["Bupropion", "has administration instruction", "tell your doctor about medicines started or stopped during treatment"], ["Bupropion", "interacts with", "prescription medicines"], ["Bupropion", "interacts with", "over-the-counter medicines"], ["Bupropion", "interacts with", "vitamins"], ["Bupropion", "interacts with", "herbal products"], ["Digoxin", "interacts with", "Bupropion"], ["Digoxin", "has effect", "decrease plasma digoxin levels"], ["Digoxin", "has monitoring requirement", "monitor digoxin levels"], ["MAOIs", "interacts with", "Bupropion"], ["MAOIs", "increases risk of", "hypertensive reactions when used with Bupropion"], ["Drugs that lower seizure threshold", "interacts with", "Bupropion"], ["Drugs that lower seizure threshold", "has administration instruction", "dose bupropion with caution"], ["CYP2B6 inducers", "interacts with", "Bupropion"], ["CYP2B6 inducers", "has administration instruction", "may require dose increase if coadministered with other CYP2B6 inducers"], ["Ritonavir", "is example of", "CYP2B6 inducer"], ["Lopinavir", "is example of", "CYP2B6 inducer"], ["Efavirenz", "is example of", "CYP2B6 inducer"], ["Carbamazepine", "is example of", "CYP2B6 inducer"], ["Phenobarbital", "is example of", "CYP2B6 inducer"], ["Phenytoin", "is example of", "CYP2B6 inducer"], ["CYP2B6 inducers", "has administration instruction", "dose increases should be based on clinical response"], ["CYP2B6 inducers", "has administration instruction", "dose increases should not exceed maximum recommended dose"], ["CYP2B6 inhibitors", "interacts with", "Bupropion"], ["CYP2B6 inhibitors", "has administration instruction", "may require dose adjustment if coadministered with CYP2B6 inhibitors"]]
Relations: ["has administration instruction", "has effect", "has monitoring requirement", "increases risk of", "interacts with", "is example of"]
Answer:

completion:
has administration instruction: The subject entity requires the specific action or guidance specified by the object entity to be followed during treatment.  
has effect: The subject entity produces the specific physiological or pharmacological effect described by the object entity.  
has monitoring requirement: The subject entity requires the specific monitoring or assessment specified by the object entity during treatment.  
increases risk of: The subject entity increases the likelihood of the adverse event or condition specified by the object entity when used in combination with other substances.  
interacts with: The subject entity has a pharmacological interaction with the other entity specified by the object entity, potentially affecting its efficacy or safety.  
is example of: The subject entity is a specific instance or example of the broader category or class specified by the object entity.
